Closed 

The Private Reserve gates access expert only terrain. We strongly recommend that you have knowledge of the area, ride with a buddy, keep your buddy in sight and that both you and your buddy wear an avalanche beacon, carry a shovel and probe and know how to use these tools. You will be riding in avalanche terrain and will encounter cliffs, creeks and waterfalls that may not be marked. Rescue will be extended. As always, only enter through open gates, ride within your ability and know before you go!

Monday, November 16: We got a dusting of snow and the forecast over the next few weeks is looking good! Get your passes and watch our live cams for the snow to fall!

Please check the General Conditions section for current Uphill Travel Info.

We are excited to see the snow return to Mt. Hood Meadows! We are currently not enforcing our uphill travel policy. If you are hiking for turns, please read the following info:

  • There is no sledding anywhere in the permit area
  • There is no patrol
  • There are no hazard markings. Expect visible and barely covered hazards
  • Stay clear of all snow removal and hauling activities
  • If you do come up to Meadows to hike for turns, you must park on the access road. Do not block the gate
  • We strongly encourage you to go elsewhere

We look forward to welcoming you back to Meadows when we are ready to open for the 2026-27 season!
